statBlock.name: Adult Black Dragon
statBlock.description: Curved horns frame its skull-like face. It keeps its hoard in a flooded swamp cave or ruined stronghold.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can choose to succeed after failing a saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dragon can first use Frightful Presence. It then attacks once with Bite and twice with Claw.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Each creature the dragon chooses within 120 ft. that is aware of it makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success. A successful save or the end of the fear grants immunity to the dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 54 (12d8) acid damage. Success halves it.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can choose one option at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use legendary actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect that the dragon did not use last round. The dragon can't take a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Surging Pool. Every pool the dragon can see within 120 ft. surges. Each creature on the ground within 20 ft. of any surging pool must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or be pulled up to 20 ft. into the water and knocked Prone.
Insect Cloud. Choose a point within 120 ft. A 20-ft.-radius cloud spreads around corners and lightly obscures the area. Each creature in the cloud when it appears makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) piercing damage. Success halves it. A creature that ends its turn in the cloud takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage. The cloud ends when the dragon dismisses it as an action, uses Insect Cloud again, or dies.
Darkness. Choose a point within 60 ft. Magical darkness spreads around corners through a 15-ft.-radius sphere. Darkvision cannot see through it and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it. If any part of the sphere overlaps light from a spell of 2nd level or lower, that spell is dispelled. The darkness ends when the dragon dismisses it as an action, uses this option again, or dies.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Within 6 miles of the lair, thick vegetation and swamp mud double travel time, and fog lightly obscures the land. Water within 1 mile is fouled. Enemies of the dragon who drink it vomit within minutes. After the dragon dies, the vegetation stays as it grew and the other effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Legendary forms: A creature taking this dragon's form gains none of its legendary actions, lair actions, or regional effects.
sections.Variant spellcasting: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, the DM chooses 3 spells of level 4 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. It uses Charisma, with spell save DC 16 and +8 to hit with spell attacks.

statBlock.description: Its black scales still have a sheen. In its swamp, it can swim beneath prey and strike from the water.

The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage, fall Prone, and become buried. While buried, it is Restrained and cannot breathe or stand up. A creature can use an action to make a DC 10 Strength check. A success ends the burial.

sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Thunderstorms and dust devils range within 6 miles of the lair. Each dust devil uses Air Elemental statistics with a speed of 50 ft., no flight, and Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1. Hidden sinkholes form in and around the lair. A creature can spot one from a safe distance with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check. If the sinkhole goes unnoticed, the first creature to step on its crust makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or falls 1d6 × 10 ft. into it. When the dragon dies, the dust devils vanish immediately, the thunderstorms end within 1d10 days, and the sinkholes remain.
